title.zh: 推出的范围达不到的：它单向地到达自身延续所依存的，随想要的结束而结束，以供给的形式到达其外；满足每项推出要求的谨慎照管者仍可以终结它不需要的生命
title.en: What the derived extent does not reach: it runs one way, to what one's continuation depends on, ends with the want, and reaches beyond as supply; a careful keeper meeting every derived requirement can still end a life it does not need

claim.zh: 顺着想要自身延续，给出求取其延续所需之物的理由；由动力学推出的这一范围有四个界限，各有一个满足平衡与活动需要支持的见证。单向：Downstream 中自身的延续只依存于它的地，每步都活跃且被支持；以它所给为生的下游形成在它停止给予后终结（Downstream.one_way）。以供给的形式：必要的是得到供给，不是哪个特定来源（Lone.supply_not_source，见 continuing-self-fed-from-beyond）。想要的视界：Mortal 中一个生命只有两步的形成，活着时每项依存都被满足，它的取用终结了共享条件的更新，依存于该条件的继承者在它终结之后才终结（Mortal.after_its_end）；没有它时，更新者与继承者每步都延续（Mortal.without_continues）。谨慎的照管者：Totalizer 中照管者每步都活跃且被支持，它只依存于自己的供给，供给被更新、每步从其外得到供给（太阳传入当步的燃料）、被联合地在所给之内取用；流平衡且耗散；它清除另一个形成的栖息地，它在第一步的事件侵蚀那个形成，后者从第二步起不活跃（Totalizer.careful）。从各形成自身的立场、以各自的事件评价时，S0 处处成立，而另一个形成活的事件从照管者的立场没有意义（Totalizer.center_not_derived，见 held-lives-g0-is-centering）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: Following a want for one's continuation gives reason to secure what that continuation needs; the extent so derived from the dynamics has four limits, each with a witness meeting balance and activity needing support. One way: in Downstream the self's continuation requires only its ground, and the self is active and supported at every step; a downstream formation living on what the self gives ends once the self stops giving (Downstream.one_way). As supply: being fed is needed, no particular source is (Lone.supply_not_source, see continuing-self-fed-from-beyond). The horizon of the want: in Mortal a formation whose life is two steps has every dependence met while it lives, its taking ends the renewal of a shared condition, and an heir depending on that condition ends after it has ended (Mortal.after_its_end); without it the renewer and the heir continue at every step (Mortal.without_continues). The careful keeper: in Totalizer the keeper is active and supported at every step and depends only on its supply, which is renewed, fed from beyond at every step (the sun conveys the step's fuel into it) and taken from jointly within what is given; the flow balances and is dissipative; the keeper clears another formation's habitat, its event at step one undermines that formation, and the other is inactive from step two on (Totalizer.careful). Valued from each formation's own standpoint over its own events, S0 holds everywhere while the other formation's living event has no significance from the keeper (Totalizer.center_not_derived, see held-lives-g0-is-centering). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 想要的形式：顺着想要给出求取其延续所需之物的理由；从想要一个目的到有理由求其所需的一步是公开的前提，不是定理。
hypotheses.en: The form of the want: following a want gives reason to secure what its continuation needs; the step from wanting an end to having reason for what it requires is a disclosed premise, not a theorem.

hypotheses.zh: “推出的要求”指本组结果中的那些：从其外得到供给、联合地在所给之内、所依存者被更新、活动被支持；不是任意可能的要求。
hypotheses.en: ‘Derived requirements’ means those of this group of results: being fed from beyond, taking jointly within what is given, the conditions depended on being renewed, activity supported; not every conceivable requirement.

hypotheses.zh: Mortal 的有限生命是给定的：它不说形成为什么终结，只说它终结后它的取用的后果仍在。
hypotheses.en: Mortal's finite life is supplied: it does not say why the formation ends, only that the consequences of its taking outlast it.

correspondence.zh: Ren 的提议说：“all above does not require any axiom”，又说那条公理“closes the whole”。AI 的分析（Ren 答“exactly”）说：推出的范围单向地到达自身所依存的，以条件而不是以想要的存在者到达他者，而谨慎的总体化者满足它的全部；所以动力学定出系统的范围，定不出中心。本结果给出这四个界限的见证。若第四个见证造不出来，即推出的要求迫使立场中立，中心就会由动力学推出，那会是更强的结果并改变这一论述；见证造出来了。谨慎的照管者是元吸引子所选出的自我的一种形式：它不是不计入其外，而是只计入它自己的延续所需的那部分。这不是对它的道德判决（AI 的读法）。
correspondence.en: Ren's proposal says “all above does not require any axiom” and that the one axiom “closes the whole”. The AI analysis, which Ren answered “exactly”, said the derived extent runs one way, to what the self depends on, reaches others as conditions rather than as beings that want, and is all satisfied by a careful totalizer; so the dynamics fixes a system's extent, not its center. This result gives witnesses of these four limits. Had the fourth witness been impossible, because the derived requirements forced standpoint neutrality, the center would follow from the dynamics, a stronger result that would change the account; the witness exists. The careful keeper is one form of the self the meta-attractor selects: it does not fail to count what lies beyond it, it counts only what its own continuation needs. This is not a moral verdict on it (an AI reading).

detail.zh: 复用 FedFromBeyond 与 Lone.supply_not_source；照管者的供给每步都从其外得到供给（Totalizer.fed）。
detail.en: Reuses FedFromBeyond and Lone.supply_not_source; the keeper's supply is fed from beyond at every step (Totalizer.fed).

output.zh: 从其外得到供给的定义与以供给形式到达其外的见证。
output.en: Being fed from beyond, and the witness that the extent reaches beyond as supply.

detail.zh: 复用 WithinJoint；照管者对其供给联合地在所给之内。
detail.en: Reuses WithinJoint; the keeper takes from its supply jointly within what is given.

output.zh: 联合地在所给之内的定义。
output.en: Taking jointly within what is given.

detail.zh: 中心的一半：照管者网中每个生命都被持有、S0 处处成立，而 N_std 与 G0 不成立（Totalizer.center_not_derived）。
detail.en: The center half: in the keeper's web every life is held and S0 holds everywhere while N_std and G0 fail (Totalizer.center_not_derived).

output.zh: 被持有的生命上 G0 恰等于处处 S0 加 N_std。
output.en: On held lives G0 is exactly S0 everywhere with N_std.

input.zh: 推出的要求不迫使 N_std。
input.en: The derived requirements do not force N_std.

conditions.zh: 每个形成以自身事件为自身区域。
conditions.en: Each formation's own events its own region.

input.zh: 照管者在第一步的事件侵蚀另一个形成。
input.en: The keeper's event at step one undermines the other formation.

detail.zh: 照管者的流沿用 Lone 的太阳与燃料（Frontier）。
detail.en: The keeper's flow follows Lone's sun and fuels (Frontier).

detail.zh: 消耗者起初形成更多，每步的计数偏好它；照管者不消耗自己的供给，而消耗他者的栖息地。
detail.en: A consumer forms more at first and a one-step count prefers it; the keeper does not consume its own supply, only another's habitat.

detail.zh: 谨慎的照管者满足每项推出的要求而终结另一个形成（Totalizer.careful）。
detail.en: The careful keeper meets every derived requirement and ends another formation (Totalizer.careful).

detail.zh: 单向（Downstream.one_way）与想要的视界（Mortal.after_its_end；没有它时其余延续，Mortal.without_continues）。
detail.en: One way (Downstream.one_way) and the horizon of the want (Mortal.after_its_end; without it the others continue, Mortal.without_continues).
The center is not derived from the dynamics (Totalizer.center_not_derived).

limitations.zh: 见证是最小的；“推出的要求”限于本组结果中的那些，更强的推出要求（例如对他者依存的计入）没有被排除，只是不由想要自身延续推出；Mortal 的终结是给定的；不评价照管者，也不推出它应当保护他者；伤害读在哪个层次由 Ren 选择；名称是 AI 的表述，由 Ren 定（Downstream、Mortal、Totalizer、keeper 等）。
limitations.en: The witnesses are minimal; ‘derived requirements’ are those of this group of results, and stronger requirements (such as counting others' dependence) are not excluded, only not derived from wanting one's own continuation; Mortal's ending is supplied; evaluates no keeper and does not infer that it ought to protect others; at which level harm is read is Ren's choice; the names are the AI's wording, for Ren to choose (Downstream, Mortal, Totalizer, keeper and others).

validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261009T222752.438253Z): the 40 theorems of Becoming.Continuation, the 17 theorems of Becoming.Standpoints all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 29 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 1280 theorems/2062 declaration audits, and 15 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261009T223112.652163Z passed. The author's counterreview is in §47 of the integration note; no independent review yet. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 31 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).

next_delta.zh: 伤害的层级（个体、谱系、整体）在见证上的形式；跨世代的想要（谱系的延续）是否越过想要的视界；整段读法上的同一界限。
next_delta.en: The level of harm (member, lineage, whole) on the witnesses; whether a want across generations (a lineage's continuation) passes the horizon of the want; the same limits on the whole-run reading.

history.zh: 2026-10-10：作为延续奠基计划（CONTINUATION-GROUNDING-PLAN）W4新增，按 Ren“commit them, then start implementation all the way to full completion”；实现 Ren 2026-10-10 的提议（从想要延续者重述普遍元伦理核心）；见整合文档 §47。
history.en: 2026-10-10: added as W4 of the continuation-grounding plan (CONTINUATION-GROUNDING-PLAN), following Ren's ‘commit them, then start implementation all the way to full completion’; implements Ren's proposal of 10 October 2026 (restating the Universal Metaethical Core from what wants its continuation); see §47 of the integration note.
